subject: maths
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: What are the coordinates of the point 3 right and 2 down from the origin?
questions.explain: Right is positive x, down is negative y: (3, -2).

questions.q: What is the y-intercept of y = 2x - 7?
questions.explain: In y = mx + c the intercept is c = -7.

questions.q: A line has gradient 2 and passes through (0, -3). What is its equation?
questions.explain: Gradient 2 and y-intercept -3 give y = 2x - 3.

questions.q: Which point lies on the line y = -x + 4?
questions.explain: For x=2, y = -2 + 4 = 2, so (2, 2) lies on the line.

questions.q: Simplify 8x^2 ÷ 2x.
questions.explain: 8÷2=4 and x^2÷x=x, giving 4x.

questions.q: What is the gradient of the line through (0, 4) and (2, 0)?
If p = 4 and q = 5, evaluate 3p^2 - q.
On y = 5x - 4, what is x when y = 11?
questions.explain: 11 = 5x - 4 gives 5x = 15, so x = 3.

questions.q: Which equation produces a cubic graph?
questions.explain: A cubic has an x^3 term, so y = x^3 + 2.

questions.q: Find the gradient of the line through (1, 2) and (4, 11).
What is the gradient of a horizontal line?
questions.explain: A horizontal line has no rise, so its gradient is 0.

questions.q: Which line is parallel to y = 3x - 2?
questions.explain: Parallel lines have the same gradient 3, so y = 3x + 5.

questions.q: Expand 3(2x - 5).
questions.explain: Multiply each term by 3: 6x - 15.

questions.q: Solve x + y = 10 and x - y = 4.
questions.explain: Adding gives 2x=14 so x=7, then y=3.

questions.q: Solve 2x + y = 11 and x - y = 1.
questions.explain: Adding gives 3x=12 so x=4, then y=3.

questions.q: Which type of graph is a U-shaped curve?
questions.explain: A quadratic such as y = x^2 produces a U-shaped parabola.

questions.q: Make x the subject of y = 4x - 3.
questions.explain: Add 3 then divide by 4: x = (y + 3)/4.

questions.q: Find the nth term of the sequence 20, 17, 14, 11, ...
questions.explain: Common difference -3; -3×1+23=20, so -3n + 23.

questions.q: If a = 3 and b = -2, find 2a - b.
On a distance-time graph, a steeper line means the object is...
questions.explain: A steeper gradient means more distance per unit time, so faster.

questions.q: Solve 3x + 7 = 22.
Solve x^2 - 7x + 10 = 0.
